title: Turkish Cheese Kunefe
description: A traditional Turkish dessert featuring melted cheese between crunchy phyllo dough, flavored with white wine and baked to perfection in a wood-fired oven. It is a Mediterranean-friendly dish perfect for a weeknight treat.
instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Layer the phyllo dough in a large baking dish, brushing each layer with melted butter.
Mix the crumbled white cheese with sugar, rose water, and salt.
Place the cheese mixture in the center of the phyllo dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the phyllo dough over the cheese, brushing the edges with water to seal.
Bake the kunefe in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove the kunefe from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Drizzle the white wine over the kunefe and serve immediately.
